items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: He was an excellent clarinet player and he's the one that actually taught me how to play clarinet. He was my only teacher as a clarinet player.

ctx.x: I don't think we ever really fully established in talking about your Uncle Ernest Royal, what his instrument was, (inaudible) that he gave you a clarinet.
Primarily, he was a saxophone and clarinet player. He was an excellent clarinet player and he's the one that actually taught me how to play clarinet. He was my only teacher as a clarinet player.
